story.title: Nina and her New Friend
paragraphs_en: It was a Tuesday morning and ten-year-old Nina was getting ready for school. Nina was already in her uniform and was about to wear her shoes. Her school-bus would arrive in fifteen minutes and Nina had just enough time to get her hair done and eat her breakfast.

Her mom came and gave her a bowl of Upma. In the busy morning, Nina was happy she got to spend time with her mom. Amma observed that her uniform has changed from last year. She told Nina, “ Your uniform has changed. You will transform into a woman as well”.

Just then, Nina heard a honk. Nina rushed to get into her bus. “What did Amma mean when she said I will become a woman?” Nina thought to herself. Her best-friend, Vinay, came and sat next to her in the bus.“ Hey, do you know why Kavita has been absent from school for the past fifteen days?” He asked her. Nina didn't know.

The whole morning at school, Nina was feeling sick,very uneasy and felt like monsters were attacking her tummy. When the bell rang, Smriti ma’am, her English Teacher came near Nina and said “ Nina, come with me to the staff-room”.
At the staff-room, Nina cried a little bit. “ My stomach has been aching since morning. I don’t know why. My body is also feeling weak”. Nina was feeling scared and puzzled.

“Nina dear, don’t worry. Your uniform has blood stains in it.Congratulations! You have attained puberty and have gotten your first period. This is very normal for a girl. Your mother will be here soon and you can have some rest at home. Here, please take this letter-we have approved your leave".

In case you have any questions, please don't hesitate to ask your mother or me or any familiar elder you feel comfortable with” Smriti ma’am said. Nina felt relieved. She was glad that she had so much support during this transitory phase. Her mother had come by then. She taught Nina to use a sanitary napkin.

On her way back home, Nina was told that she should be careful about hygiene, particularly during her periods. As her mother was buying more sanitary napkins, Nina was told that her favorite meal- Rajma rice was being prepared at home as a celebration. Nina skipped happily!
